explication: This repository is OpsiMate’s Docusaurus documentation site, not the OpsiMate operations console itself. The main user workflow is to open the docs landing page, choose a topic, and browse the corresponding guides through the configured sidebar. The map also includes consent-gated analytics and the documented product areas; documentation content is represented by its exact directories because its page implementations were not sampled.
